name: The Royal Sonesta San Juan
insider_take: This beachfront gem sits on pristine Isla Verde Beach, where turquoise waters meet golden sand just steps from San Juan's vibrant energy.
whats_special: The Royal Sonesta occupies prime real estate on one of Puerto Rico's most coveted beaches, featuring direct access to Isla Verde's crystalline waters. The hotel's stunning Spanish colonial architecture perfectly complements its position along the island's northeastern coast, where the Atlantic Ocean creates some of the Caribbean's most spectacular sunrises.
pro_tip: Book an ocean-facing room on the upper floors for unobstructed sunrise views over the Atlantic – the hotel's eastward orientation makes it one of the best spots in Puerto Rico to catch the first light of day.
dont_miss: The nearby Laguna del Condado offers world-class paddleboarding and kayaking just minutes away, while Old San Juan's historic El Morro fortress and colorful cobblestone streets are a quick 15-minute drive. The hotel's beachfront location also puts you at the heart of Isla Verde's legendary nightlife and casino scene.
pros: Prime beachfront location on Isla Verde Beach
Multiple dining options including oceanfront restaurants
Close proximity to Luis Muñoz Marín International Airport
cons: High-traffic tourist area with busy beach
